name: The Dog House – Royal Hunt

features.name: Wild multipliers
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 carry 2x or 3x multipliers that combine on the same line.

features.name: Free spins reveal
features.description: A 3x3 grid determines the number of free spins, up to 27.

features.name: Sticky wilds
features.description: Wilds that land in the bonus stay put with their multipliers until the round ends.

review:
The classic Dog House in medieval dress. Wilds on reels 2, 3 and 4 carry random 2x or 3x multipliers that combine when they share a line.

Bonus symbols on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger free spins, and a separate 3x3 grid spins first to decide how many – up to 27. Every wild in the bonus sticks with its multiplier, so that spin count matters a lot. Up to 8,000x, 96.5% RTP. Like the original, with extra suspense.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
